title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT with Business Agents
content:
X author: @OpenAI

OpenAI shipped Business Hub in beta, allowing eligible U.S. ecommerce and service businesses to claim profiles, publish labeled Business Agents that answer customer questions using provided data, and view aggregated insights on mentions, clicks, and topics without sharing conversations.
